args.title: Summary: Juniper warehouse automation 2026 (blog + companion)
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.juniper.example/2026/warehouse and its companion piece (https://insights.juniper.example/warehouse/companion):

- Autonomous carts lifted warehouse pick rates by 18% in 2026.
- Integration took twice as long as planned, a notable implementation challenge.
- The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks (per the companion piece).
